title: Deontic Verbal Adjectives with -andó and -endő ('to be done / must be done')

sections.title: Formation and Functional Meaning
sections.content: The suffix -andó/-endő attaches to transitive verb stems to form future passive/deontic adjectives expressing prescription, imperative requirement, or necessary action. In judicial and legislative registers, megsemmisítendő means 'that must be annulled', alkalmazandó means 'applicable / to be applied', and követendő means 'to be followed / obligatory'.

sections.title: Attributive vs. Predicative Syntactic Roles
sections.content: They function attributively modifying a noun ('az alkalmazandó jogszabályok') or predicatively with copula van/volt: 'Az alkotmányellenes rendelet megsemmisítendő' (The unconstitutional decree is to be struck down). In the plural predicate position, they take -k: alkalmazandók, követendők.

sections.title: Frequent Deontic Adjectives in Legal Register
rows: to apply -> applicable / to be applied
to annul -> must be annulled / to be struck down
to consider -> to be taken into consideration
to protect -> to be protected / deserving protection

items.spanish: Az alaptörvénybe ütköző jogszabály a bíróság döntése értelmében haladéktalanul megsemmisítendő.
items.english: The statute colliding with the Fundamental Law is to be annulled without delay under the court's decision.

items.spanish: A vizsgálat során a nemzetközi emberi jogi egyezmények is figyelembe veendők.
items.english: During the review, international human rights conventions are also to be taken into consideration.

items.spanish: A vitatott eljárásban kizárólag a hatályos eljárásjogi szabályok alkalmazandók.
items.english: In the contested proceeding, only the procedural rules in force are to be applied.

sections.title: B2 Usage Notice
sections.content: Back vowels take -andó (alkalmazandó, vizsgálandó); front vowels take -endő (megsemmisítendő, követendő). In predicate position with plural subjects, add plural -k (alkalmazandók).
